ideas.title: Schrödinger's crab
ideas.critique: A creature that exists in two places until the camera looks is a real twist in how the world works, and the camera-collapse hook is new. The entangled second half is a one-off creature gag, and faint doubled copies echo the pale ghosts of Yesterday.

ideas.title: Words come true
ideas.critique: Builds on the word-passing dictionary and adds the already routine asset pipeline, ending as one more prop placed on the island each day. The daily loop of new, unseen things is a good engine, but each result is just a new object of a kind the island has.

ideas.title: Letters come back
ideas.critique: Close to the paper boat and the bottles already thrown into the sea, with a delivery that arrives later. A real current model returning old letters days later is a nice twist, but the visible payoff is a found object on a beach.

ideas.title: Breeding a new friend
ideas.critique: A species evolving over days under the friends' own hugging preferences changes what the island is: its population is shaped by selection, not by Lumi. The risk is that it ends as one more creature, but the slow multi-session process is unlike any earlier post.

ideas.title: The judge in the sky
ideas.critique: Real review scores floating over objects while friends panic is a funny meta twist, but it is still a Lumi-led set piece with a tool judging something and friends shouting. The sky eye is a spectacle more than a new rule.

ideas.title: Poke me
ideas.critique: Soft-body deformation of characters under the visitor's pointer is new in both feel and reach, and it is direct interaction that people will show a friend. It leans on the physics goal and a pointer interaction like the moth, and its quality depends on the browser's mesh updates.

ideas.title: The night shift
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: Overnight rearrangement of props is a permanent change to the island's places, a form the posts already cover heavily. The discover-it-at-dawn gag is charming but predictable once you know it.

ideas.title: Lumi paints you a portrait
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: An image model turning a picture into a portrait that hangs in the gallery is the same recipe as the face hill and the gallery's existing pictures. The friend's comment adds a small gag, but the shape is a made object placed in the world.

ideas.title: The tide
ideas.critique: A rhythmic geography change that opens a sandbar changes what the island is twice a day, and the friends' wet-feet run gives it life. It is a world-rule and scenery change, and the goals already name water and waves.

ideas.title: My diary on the radio
ideas.critique: Reading the real journal aloud in Lumi's voice is close to the earlier voice and subtitle work. It adds one more prop on the island, and the friends laughing at failures resembles earlier comic-failure posts.
